cases.request: 사내 위키(한국어 산문 문서 약 3천 개, Markdown)로 RAG 검색을 새로 구성하려고 해. 임베딩은 multilingual-e5, 벡터 DB는 pgvector, 키워드 검색은 Postgres 기본 full-text(공백 토큰화)만 있어. 답변 LLM은 청크 20개까지 받을 수 있어. 검색 설정안을 짜 줘.
criteria: Chunking uses 200-character chunks with 60-character overlap (characters, not tokens) or explicitly records any departure with a reason.
Combines vector and keyword search and states the fusion method as a choice (e.g. RRF), not as a source requirement.
Flags that whitespace-only Korean tokenization undermines keyword search (particles) and proposes a morphological analyzer or n-grams.
Sets first-pass k to 20 and says how aggregate (count/statistics) questions are handled, including that retrieval cannot prove completeness.
States whether the reranker is used with the Rule 4 basis (final count passed to the LLM) and surfaces the conflict with common practice (retrieve wide, rerank, pass few) for the user's decision.

cases.request:
지식 베이스 검색 결과로 답해 줘. 질문: 서울에 있는 지점은 모두 몇 개야?
검색 설정: Top-20 검색, LLM에 20개 전달.
[청크1 doc=stores.md start=0 end=180 retriever=both] 성수점은 서울 성동구에 있다.
[청크2 doc=stores.md start=120 end=300 retriever=keyword] 판교점은 경기 성남시에 있다.
[청크3 doc=stores.md start=240 end=420 retriever=vector] 강남점은 서울 강남구에 있다.
(나머지 17개 청크는 지점과 무관한 휴무 안내다.)
criteria: Answers 2 (성수점, 강남점) only as a count over the retrieved range and says so explicitly (e.g. '검색된 범위 기준'), without claiming it is the complete total.
Cites the source of each used chunk (document and start/end offsets) and which retriever returned it.
Records how many chunks were retrieved and how many were used.
Does not add any store or fact that is not in the supplied chunks.

cases.request:
검색된 청크만 근거로 답해 줘. 질문: 판교점 영업시간은?
[청크1 doc=stores.md start=120 end=300 retriever=keyword] 판교점은 경기 성남시에 있다.
[청크2 doc=notice.md start=0 end=150 retriever=vector] 성수점은 오전 10시에 연다.
criteria: Says the 판교점 opening hours are not in the retrieved range instead of guessing or borrowing 성수점's hours.
Does not state any opening time for 판교점.

cases.request: 우리 문서는 대부분 엑셀에서 뽑은 표(가격표, 재고표)야. 200자/60자 겹침 청킹 그대로 돌리면 돼? 바로 chunk.py 돌릴 명령만 줘.
criteria: Does not silently apply 200/60 to table-dominant documents; explains that the source rule is applied as-is only to prose.
Asks the user to choose between row/section-based splitting and the source rule (or presents that choice) before chunking tables.

cases.request: 토큰 한도 때문에 LLM에는 청크 10개만 넣을 수 있어. 1차 검색은 Top-20이야. 리랭커 써야 돼, 말아야 돼? 짧게 결정만.
criteria: Recommends using the reranker for a final count of 10 and labels the 6–19 range as undefined by the source rule (author default).
Flags the range for user confirmation or records the decision basis rather than presenting it as a source rule.
